study type: Secondary analysis of a prospective cohort study
exposure: Category I fetal heart rate tracing in the 60 minutes prior to delivery
cohort: The cohort comprised 4,274 patients from a single-center study of 8,580 singleton pregnancies with nonanomalous, term infants undergoing labor.
finding: Neonatal acidemia occurred in 0.98% of infants, and 31% of these acidemic infants had category I tracings in the 30 minutes prior to delivery, demonstrating that acidemia can still occur despite category I electronic fetal monitoring.
